title: dietary diversity of the amami rabbit endemic to insular evergreen forests
author: kei'ichiro iguchi

materials: were collected from the Asato forest road (28.22° N, 129.34° E). DNA Extraction : DNA was extracted from the collected fecal samples using the following protocol: Freeze-drying: Samples were freeze-dried using a VD-250R Freeze Dryer (TAITEC). Homogenization: Freeze-dried samples were crushed at 1,500 rpm for 2 minutes using a Multi-Beads Shocker (Yasui Kikai). Lysis: Lysis Solution F (Nippon Gene) was added to the homogenized samples and incubated at 65°C for 10 minutes. Centrifugation and Supernatant Separation: Samples were centrifuged at 12,000 x g for 2 minutes, and the supernatant was collected. Purification: Purification Solution (Nippon Gene) and chloroform were added to the separated supernatant and thoroughly mixed. Second Centrifugation: The mixture was centrifuged at 12,000 x g for 15 minutes, and the supernatant was again collected. DNA Purification: DNA was further purified from this solution using a Lab-Aid824s DNA Extraction kit (ZEESAN). PCR Inhibitor Removal: PCR inhibitors were removed using a DNeasy PowerClean Pro Cleanup Kit (Qiagen). Library Construction and psbA Gene Sequencing : The psbA gene, a commonly used marker for plant identification, was targeted for sequencing. DNA Quantification: DNA solution concentration was measured using Synergy LX (Agilent Technologies) and the QuantiFluor dsDNA System (Promega). Library Construction: Libraries were constructed using the 2-step tailed PCR method. Library Quantification and Quality Control: The concentration of the prepared libraries was measured using Synergy H1 (Agilent Technologies) and the QuantiFluor dsDNA System. Library quality was confirmed using a Fragment Analyzer and dsDNA 915 Reagent Kit (Agilent Technologies). Sequencing: Sequencing was performed on a MiSeq system (Illumina) under 2x300 bp conditions using a MiSeq Reagent Kit v3 (Illumina). Data Analysis : Bioinformatic analysis of the sequencing data was performed as follows: Primer Matching and Trimming: Read sequences perfectly matching the primer sequence at the start were extracted using fastx_barcode_splitter from FASTX-Toolkit (v0.0.14). The primer sequence and 50 bases at the 3' end were then removed using fastx_trimmer from FASTX-Toolkit. Quality Filtering: Sequences with a quality value less than 20 were removed using sickle (v1.33). Sequences with a length of 40 bases or less, along with their paired sequences, were discarded. Paired-End Read Joining: Paired-end reads were joined using FLASH (v1.2.

steps.title: Collect fecal samples
steps.instruction: Gather rabbit fecal material on the specified dates and locations, recording sample IDs and GPS coordinates.

substeps.instruction: August 18, 2022 – collect two samples (A‑rab‑1 and A‑rab‑2) on Amami Oshima Island, Japan.
October 28, 2023 – collect four samples (A‑rab‑3, A‑rab‑4, A‑rab‑5, A‑rab‑6) from the Yakugachi River basin (28.22° N, 129.34° E).
Additional samples were also taken from the Asato forest road (28.22° N, 129.34° E) for psbA sequencing.

steps.title: Freeze‑dry samples
steps.instruction: Place each fecal sample in a VD‑250R Freeze Dryer (TAITEC) and dry until all moisture is removed.

steps.title: Homogenize dried material
steps.instruction: Grind the freeze‑dried feces at 1,500 rpm for 2 min using a Multi‑Beads Shocker (Yasui Kikai).

steps.title: Lyse cells
steps.instruction: Add Lysis Solution F (Nippon Gene) to the homogenate and incubate at 65 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 12,000 × g for 2 min and transfer the supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Purify supernatant
steps.instruction: Add Purification Solution (Nippon Gene) and chloroform to the collected supernatant, mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 12,000 × g for 15 min and collect the upper aqueous phase.

steps.title: DNA purification
steps.instruction: Purify DNA from the aqueous phase using a Lab‑Aid824s DNA Extraction kit (ZEESAN) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Remove PCR inhibitors
steps.instruction: Treat the purified DNA with a DNeasy PowerClean Pro Cleanup Kit (Qiagen) to eliminate inhibitors.

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a Synergy LX (Agilent Technologies) fluorometer and the QuantiFluor dsDNA System (Promega).

steps.title: Construct libraries
steps.instruction: Generate sequencing libraries using the 2‑step tailed PCR method targeting the psbA gene.

steps.title: Library QC and quantification
steps.instruction: Determine library concentration with a Synergy H1 (Agilent Technologies) fluorometer and the QuantiFluor dsDNA System; assess fragment size using a Fragment Analyzer with the dsDNA 915 Reagent Kit (Agilent Technologies).

steps.title: Sequence libraries
steps.instruction: Run the libraries on an Illumina MiSeq system under 2 × 300 bp paired‑end conditions using a MiSeq Reagent Kit v3 (Illumina).

steps.title: Bioinformatic processing
steps.instruction: Perform the following data‑analysis pipeline on the raw reads.

substeps.instruction: Primer matching and trimming: extract reads that perfectly match the primer at the 5′ end using fastx_barcode_splitter (FASTX‑Toolkit v0.0.14), then remove the primer and the last 50 bp with fastx_trimmer.
Quality filtering: discard reads with a quality value < 20 using sickle v1.33 and remove any read ≤ 40 bp together with its pair.
Paired‑end joining: merge forward and reverse reads with FLASH v1.2.
Database comparison: align representative sequences against the NCBI nt database requiring a minimum overlap of 10 bases.
Chimera and noise removal: run the dada2 plugin in Qiime2 v2023.7 to eliminate chimeric reads and generate an ASV table.
Phylogenetic estimation: BLASTN (v2.13) the representative sequences against NCBI nt using default parameters.
Data visualization: convert .qzv files to viewable format with the exportplugin of Qiime2.
